lines.en: Meanwhile, in the actual bathroom that Noriko ran off to...
: Uhh...Noriko? I don’t really wanna be a buzzkill or whatever, but this is a Halloween party and it’s prooooobably not the best time to lock yourself inside of a bathroom and cry.
: It’s not locked! The door is open!
: Okay, whatever. But still...what the hell is going on?
: It’s not like you to actually cry and I’m pretty sure you are actually crying right now.
: I am actually crying!
: Okaaaaay...Can you at least tell me why?
: I’m pretty bad at cheering people up, but your options are kinda limited right now.
: Besides, like...50%% of the other girls think I’m a slut and won’t talk to me, sooooo I really don't have anything else to do right now.
: *Sniff* Gee, I wonder why they'd think something like that.
: Same. Everyone knows that I’m just an innocent little girl who, on occasion, tries to get her teacher to fuck her.
: Perfectly normal behavior, if you ask me.
: *Sniff*
: Just tell me what happened. Is this about the thing with your sister?
: Ahhhhhhhhh I don’t understand! I mean...I do understand...but that doesn’t help me understand it any better!
: ...What?
: I’m trying so so so hard to make him want me...and...I think he does...but then Niki swoops in right before I’m able to take things to the next level and now I’m confused again!
: What if he realizes I’m just, like...the Walmart version of her?!
: The less successful one who doesn’t eat meat and has less experience giving handjobs and stuff!
: I mean...I don’t speak for Sensei, but I think it’s safe to assume he has a thing for [teenager]s if he’s here with us now instead of her.
: Also, the entire idea of attaching love to sex and stuff is like, definitely not a thing he cares about.
: He was probably just...bored and trying to get it wet. I get it.
: I’d understand if it was someone else, but this is my sister we’re talking about!
: They were together every day for years! They’re perfect for each other! What if...what if they remember that?!
: What will happen to me?!
: I don’t know, girl. You’ll...go back to the way things used to be, I guess?
: Secretly fingering yourself while watching the boy you like fuck someone who looks eerily similar to you doesn’t sound as bad as like...knowing it’s happening and not watching?
: That really only happened like...one or two times.
: And I didn’t even fully understand what I was doing yet.
: The only reason I keep bringing it up to Sensei is because I want him to know how much I want him now.
: Besides...you have a sister. How would you feel if you had to sit on the sidelines and watch Sensei have sex with her?
: Umm...
: Honestly?...
: Not...that bad.
: *Sniff*...Ew.
: Karin will literally never take a dick, though. So this is probably closer to another fantasy in my head than your...situation.
: But, basically, the part that I’m having trouble getting to is that none of that matters.
: Even if Sensei does get back together with your sister, it’s not like you’ll just...vanish or something. Relationships end all the time.
: Dwelling too much on him fingering her instead of you is just going to make shit all weird when it’s actually your turn, you know?
: Ahhhhhh this is so fucking annoying! I was doing so good at not being the clingy little sister type!
: You’re...good at that now, too. Crying in front of me literally doesn’t matter since you’re like...one of the two friends I actually care about.
: Keeping up these charades all the time is going to tire you out, Noriko. You need to loosen up.
: Go have some fun. Fuck with other people just to see what happens. Masturbate in a...library or something. I don’t know.
: Oh! Wanna go suck Sensei’s dick with me? That should make you feel better, right?
: What?...No!
: Kirin, I don’t want to go suck Sensei’s dick with you.
: Oh.
: Well I thought it was a good idea.
: I’m not like you.
: Sure you are. I’ve seen your search history.
: Okay, so I’m not entirely unlike you...but I’m in love with Sensei and I’m afraid that he’ll overlook that very important fact if I just start...sucking him off with my roommate.
: But what will adding love into the mix even change when he’s like...allergic to that kind of shit?
: That just makes it sound a lot harder for you to actually get what you want.
: Yeah...
: And, you know, it might be harder doing things that way.
: But I’m not looking for just...an outlet to get all of the feelings that I’ve kept bottled up for so long out.
: I’m looking for the guy who means the world to me to acknowledge that I’m not the same person I was when we were younger.
: That I’m an actual independent girl now and not just his girlfriend’s sister.
: You know what that’s like, don’t you? Living in someone else’s shadow for so long that you start to think you’re only as good as the things they outgrow?
: We didn’t start steps behind- we started like...nine flights of stairs down.
: And even if we start running up those stairs until our hearts feel like they’re going to explode, we won’t be able to catch up.
: This metaphor needs an elevator or something.
: Kirin, I love Sensei. I love him so so so so so so much.
: Wait, you’re not about to tell me to stop fucking around with him, are you? Because, not gonna lie, his dick is kinda like crack.
: No...I’m...mostly okay with you two acting the way you do because I know you’re not trying to make it into anything else...
: But this is probably a situation where you've just gotta realize...that you can’t really help me.
: We’re too far apart in what we want and...what we value.
: I want to...grow old with him. And you want-
: Him to tie me up and fuck me in front of the class.
: I want to poke his sleeping face in the mornings and smile at him as he wakes up...and you-
: Want to wake up to the feeling of his gigantic cock turning my insides to Jell-O.
: And I...want love. While you-
: Want an uninterrupted, highly passionate threesome with my roommate that may or may not end with me orally stimulating her to the point of orgasm.
: Would that cheer you up?
: I don’t think so.
: Cause I’ll do it. Don’t test me.
: Kirin, no. As great as it would be for stuff like that to cheer me up, I...just don’t think it would.
: The damage has already been done this time and I’m not going to feel any better until I can be convinced that...none of what happened really meant anything.
: I’d love to be able to believe Sensei when he tells me that it was just a spontaneous get-together, but...
: Her fucking smile, Kirin...She wants him back.
: Okaaaaay...but she doesn’t have him yet. So why are you crying?
: Because I’m worried! Normal people cry when they’re worried! This is something you’d know if your brain wasn’t replaced with a remote-controlled sex toy!
: My brain being replaced with a sex toy is the best possible thing that could have ever happened to me.
: Look at you right now. Why would I ever want to be in that position?
: Why waste time worrying when you can just...not worry at all and have orgasms and stuff?
: That outlook’s going to catch up to you one day, Kirin...
: And when it does, it’s not going to be pretty.
: Well then I guess I’d better enjoy myself while I still can, huh?
: Do you...
: Do you really not feel any sort of love at all?
: I feel...
: Annoyed that we’re still talking about this. And that you’re still crying.
: Is it all out of your system yet? Can we go back to the party and show everyone how attractive we are?
: And then maybe, if your mind changes by the end of the night, pull our teacher aside and have our first cum-swapping experience together as BFFs?
: I thought Miku was your BFF?
: My BFF is whichever one of you two I am closer to having a threesome with. And even with Miku taking up a sudden interest in sexual stuff, I think that person is you.
: Her too now? Really?
: If it makes you feel any better, I don’t know if anything has happened with her and Sensei yet...but she’s certainly seemed more curious than normal lately.
: Finally reunited with the man of my dreams after years of being apart and literally everyone wants to fuck him. What is my life?
: Well, hey! It could be worse! He could be already fucking all of them. All things considered, you’re still pretty early to the game, Noriko.
: You’re really not helping here.
: I know.
: I told you, I’m not great at stuff like this.
: But I like you enough to follow you in here, and that’s more than I can say for most people.
: It sucks to be the one to break it to you, but the life you want is never going to happen.
: And even if it was, you sure as fuck wouldn’t get there by crying on the floor of a bathroom stall.
: If you really think you’ve become some sort of...concoction of all of the things Sensei likes while still maintaining your sense of individuality, the fuck are you doing right now?
: Sensei hates when girls cry. It’s a complete boner killer for him.
: I know that..
: But I can’t control everything, Kirin.
: Can you control your legs? Because if so, we can walk right on out of here and pretend this little breakdown never even happened.
: If we can find our way back, that is. This house has so many fucking bathrooms.
: It really does! What is up with that?!
: I don’t know. Just...rich people shit I-
: Wait...did you hear that just now?
: Hm? Hear what?
: I don’t know, but...I could have sworn I heard someone come in here.
: *Sniff*...Ngh...
: How’s my makeup? Do I look okay?
: No. You look like you just watched your dog get run over by a car.
: Don’t joke about that. My dog actually was hit by a car a long time ago.
: And you’re still crying about it? Get over yourself.
: Come here. Let me see your face.
: Okay...but if you try to kiss me again, I swear.
: Shh. Lemme see.
: How precious it is to see the misguided continue to wander.
: Through the twists and turns of this porcelain labyrinth, pushed deep behind the shadows that few dare to journey beyond.
: It is almost as if this is where they belong.
: Trapped within the confines of a temporary prison, with all the things required to convert it into the loveliest of homes scattered throughout it, waiting to be arranged.
: I hope they are enjoying their stay here- away from the blanket of despair being draped over the others.
: Something horrible is coming. How will you remain warm?
: Return.
: Yasu?...
: Hello again.
: What are you doing in here? Where’s Touka?
: I appear to have gotten lost. How ironic.
: Uh...what about that is ironic, exactly?
: Probably cause like...she’s always talking about helping those who are lost find their way or something?
: Are you interested in finding the way as well?
: I can show you if you are.
: Oh, damn. I can see everything from this angle.
: I’m...okay for now. But thank you.
: Do you need help getting back to the party? Kirin and I were just about to leave.
: That sounds wonderful. Thank you so much for your assistance.
: I’m sorry for being such a burden.
: It’s fine. Don’t worry about it at all.
: You ready, Kirin?
: Kirin?
: Oh. Uhhhhhhhhh...
: Actually, you two can go on without me. I’ll catch up with you in a little while.
: Are you...sure? Because...we’re kind of in a maze and...
: Yup. I’m good. Bye now.
: She’s so pretty.
: Have...
: Have we really been in the men's room this entire time?
Noriko and Yasu head back to the party!
